footer.restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? It replaces ALL current app data with the file contents.
footer.restored: Backup restored. The app will now reload.
footer.clearConfirm1: Clear all app data on this device? This cannot be undone.
footer.clearConfirm2: Really clear everything? Export a backup first if you need one.

footer.tagline: Free browser games — no accounts, no downloads.
footer.bugCopy1: This app is built and maintained entirely by a 76-year-old independent developer living on a homestead. There is no corporate support desk, and I don't have the time or energy to answer individual support emails.
footer.bugCopy2: However, if you spot a bug or broken feature, let me know anyway! I regularly update and patch the app, so your bug reports go straight into the fix queue for the next update.
footer.copyInfoHint: Copies anonymous app details — no personal data. Pasting it into your bug report is optional, but it helps find the problem faster.
footer.suggestCopy1: This app is built and maintained entirely by a 76-year-old independent developer living on a homestead. I only build features that I personally find useful or enjoy crafting, so I can't promise to build every suggestion.
footer.suggestCopy2: However, if you have a brilliant idea for a lightweight, privacy-first game, share it anyway! If it tickles my curiosity, it just might show up in a future update.
footer.copyIdeaHint: Your idea is copied — paste it into a GitHub issue or anywhere handy.

snake.instructions: Eat the food to grow. Don't hit the walls or your own tail.

snake.controlsTouch: Swipe or use the D-pad to steer

memory.instructions: Flip two tiles to match related words — synonyms and word associations.

minesweeper.instructions: Reveal tiles without hitting a mine. Numbers show adjacent mines — flag the ones you suspect.

lexicon.question: Question
lexicon.instructions: Pick the definition that matches the word. 10 questions per round — speed and streaks earn bonus points.

wordguess.instructions: Guess the hidden five-letter word in six tries.

wordladder.instructions: Turn the start word into the target — change exactly one letter per step; every step must be a real word.
guideSteps: Change exactly one letter per step.
Every step must be a real word from the list.
Reach the target word to win — fewer steps means more points.
Stuck? A hint fills in the best next word but costs 150 points.

down: Ice crystals on a cold morning

2048.instructions: Merge tiles with the same number and reach 2048.
2048.controlsDesktop: Arrow keys or WASD to slide the tiles
2048.ruleSlide: Slide: arrow keys, WASD or swiping moves every tile in that direction.
2048.ruleMerge: Merge: two tiles with the same number fuse into one worth double.
2048.ruleSpawn: Spawn: after every move a new 2 (usually) or 4 tile appears in a free cell.
2048.ruleGoal: Goal: build a 2048 tile. The game ends when the board fills with no merges left.

reaction.instructions: Tap the pad the instant it turns green. Five rounds — tapping too early is a foul and the round restarts.
reaction.hint: Score = 5000 ÷ average reaction time in ms. Faster is higher.

math-drill.instructions: 60 seconds on the clock. Each correct answer scores 50 + 10 × your current streak — a wrong answer resets the streak.
math-drill.hint: Press Enter or the Answer button to submit.

simon.instructions: Watch the sequence, then repeat it by tapping the pads in order. Each round adds one step — one mistake ends the game.

breakout.instructions: Move the paddle to keep the ball in play and break every brick. Three lives — clearing the board speeds things up.
breakout.controlsDesktop: Move: mouse or ← → · Launch: Space or ↑
breakout.controlsTouch: Drag to move the paddle · tap to launch

typing.instructions: Type the sentence exactly as shown. Three sentences — speed counts, but accuracy counts twice.
typing.hint: Score = WPM × 10 × accuracy². Being precise beats being fast.
sentences: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Practice makes perfect when you type every day.
A calm mind types faster than a hurried one.
Fresh coffee and a quiet room help you focus.
Small steps every day lead to big results.
The sun sets slowly behind the green hills.
Good habits are built one keystroke at a time.
Clear skies make the long walk worth taking.
Every expert was once a beginner who kept going.
The river flows gently through the old town.
Write it down before the idea slips away.
Patience and rhythm beat speed every single time.

connect-four.instructions: Drop your discs into a column and connect four in a row — horizontally, vertically or diagonally — before the computer does.
connect-four.hint: Score on a win = depth × 200 + (21 − your moves) × 20. Harder AI and fewer moves pay more.

fifteen.instructions: Slide the numbered tiles into order — tap a tile next to the gap, or use the arrow keys.
fifteen.hint: Score = 1000 − (5 × moves) − seconds. Fewer, faster moves pay more.

aim.instructions: Tap each target as it appears — you have 30 seconds. Each hit scores 10 points.
aim.hint: Steady beats fast — missed taps don't add points.
